quests.title: Phantom Flow: Phantasmal Blade

dialogue.t: Hello. My name is Shousen. I'm the master of Shinryuu.
From your appearance, you must be a traveler from afar. What do you say? Are you interested in learning this art?

This is an original skill that I invented. It's different from the Iwakura and Kitain Arts — or even the Favonius Bladework from overseas — which all require weapons for combat, in the sense that the essence of my technique is exercising one's heart to hone one's combat skills.
In my early years, I traveled abroad to study martial arts. There, I observed Natlan's boxing arts. When they practiced, they would fight with an imaginary opponent.

dialogue.sit: So you fight with your imaginary friend?

dialogue.t: Precisely. You imagine your opponent's actions and react based on your own imagination. This practice, which the locals there call "shadow boxing," appeared to be a rather lofty skill to me.
As such, Shinryuu is an unrestricted school of fighting that makes use of this practice method. Under my guidance, you can recreate all manner of imaginary opponents.

From slimes to ochimusha, and even to those outlander warriors from Snezhnaya. So long as you are well-versed in the art of Shinryuu, you can easily recreate a battle with them to hone your combat skills.

By the way, I'm afraid that the mightiest creature in the world is the Electro Crystalfly. Eiin, the previous Iwakura successor, once tried to challenge a human-shaped Electro Crystalfly using Shinryuu. He barely lasted ten seconds.
This art is not limited to opponents alone. I can even simulate the wind direction, weather, mechanisms and even Ley Line Disorders using Shinryuu. It is a truly practical skill.
Paimon's gotta ask, if Shinryuu is already so strong, why do you still need to ask people to join yourself, Mr. Shousen?
My Shinryuu is a little too... real, to the point where my disciples can become injured when fighting their imaginary foes.
Even an imaginary blade created by Shinryuu can slice your hands and feet. A musket so imagined can also shoot through your body.

As time goes by, people who are not devoted to the martial arts will leave Shinryuu out of fear. As for some others, I judged that they were manic martial desperados, unsuited to mastering this art, and so I kicked them out.
Indeed. However, I believe that you are most suitable for the art of Shinryuu. Perhaps fated to use it, even. Would you like to give it a go?
Well, if you are interested, just imagine the platform in front of you as the Shinryuu arena.
I will then tailor-make the most suitable battlefield for you by the power of Shinryuu.
Be careful, and mind you don't get hurt. After all..

quests.description: There is a rather unique martial arts school in Inazuma, and its name is “Shinryuu.”
